subject: Planned data deletion completed
body: Cockpit Chess removed data it no longer uses after the scheduled waiting period. No action is required.
fallbackEffects: Data listed in the database change’s contract.sql
recovery: If you need this data back, ask your maintainer to recover only the required records from the plain-dump backup. The restore command replaces the entire database and would undo later changes; preview it first and use the recovery instructions in docs/schema-migrations.md.
noBackup: No backup was configured before this deletion. Ask your maintainer about other recovery options and setting up backups.
